clips.title: The story
paras: North of Dolanaar, Fel Rock has fallen under a spreading corruption. Lord Melenas and his grells have turned the once-tranquil cavern into a threat within Teldrassil’s woods.

North of Dolanaar, Fel Rock lies among Teldrassil’s forested hills. Once a peaceful cavern in wood and stone, it is now overtaken by twisted roots, unnatural shadows, wild grells and grellkin. The taint reaches into the world tree’s boughs.

Lord Melenas, a satyr, has claimed Fel Rock as his stronghold. From within the cavern, he spreads corruption beneath the watch of the night elf sentinels. Druids in Dolanaar, including Tallonkai Swiftroot, seek defenders to cleanse the cave and slay Melenas before the blight reaches farther into the surrounding woodlands.
